initial_failure_and_fix.root_cause: The backend imported its runtime layout from process-level XREPORT_RESOURCES_DIR, then dotenv loading replaced that environment variable from settings/.env. The spawned worker inherited the overwritten empty value and resolved the default database instead of the parent's isolated database.
initial_failure_and_fix.fix: Preserve an explicit non-empty process-level XREPORT_RESOURCES_DIR across dotenv override so spawned workers resolve the same resources directory.
